entries.note: This is a loopback-only desktop service. HTTP and WebSocket requests need the private runtime token and compatible Origin; it is not the Quest pairing protocol. Tokens stay in mode-0600 local state, never tracked files. Slow sockets reconnect to bounded retained output without stopping sessions. The retired browser bundle is no longer served; unknown non-API paths return 404. A later web client requires an explicit separate delivery decision.
